trimmed_dict.title: 2026-27 Returning Student Room Selection Room Change Process
trimmed_dict.description:
As spaces become available due to students transferring, withdrawling, or changing rooms, any open and available space will be placed into the Room Change Process for returning students to select into.

 

This process opens at 9 a.m. on April1 and will closed on July 31 at 12 p.m. noon. The room change process is an individual process (no roommate groups).
